description.zh: 数顶点、棱、面验证欧拉公式；放大 k 倍时表面积 ×k²、体积 ×k³；平面截立方体得到 3、4、5、6 边形，垂直于体对角线时从三角形到正六边形；切片累加得金字塔体积 1/3；用滚动法判断展开图能否折成立方体。正交投影的教学模型。
description.en: Count vertices, edges and faces to check Euler’s formula; scaling by k multiplies surface area by k² and volume by k³; a plane cutting a cube gives 3-, 4-, 5- or 6-sided sections, from a triangle to a regular hexagon perpendicular to the space diagonal; slice sums give a pyramid’s volume as one third; a rolling test decides whether a net folds into a cube. An orthographic-projection teaching model.

formula: V − E + F = 2,  S ∝ k²,  V ∝ k³,  V_锥 = Sh/3

label.en: From flat views back to the solid

reason.zh: 三视图把立体压成平面图；本页第 0 步让你自己转动立体，看顶点、棱、面如何在不同角度下呈现。
reason.en: Three views flatten a solid into drawings; step 0 here lets you turn the solid yourself and see how vertices, edges and faces appear from different angles.

label.zh: 切片累加就是积分的雏形
label.en: Adding slices is the seed of integration

reason.zh: 第 4 步把金字塔切成 k 层并累加“截面积×厚度”，随着 k 增大趋近 H/3，正是定积分的思想。
reason.en: Step 4 slices a pyramid into k layers and adds “area × thickness”, tending to H/3 as k grows — the idea of a definite integral.

title.zh: 立方体能被切出几种形状？
title.en: What shapes can a cube be cut into?

note: three-views is a page slug (b1 batch); integral is an atlas node.
